description: This source file provides utility functions for reading files into memory and printing their contents, specifically for unit testing purposes in the 'ut_test_common' module. It includes functions for opening a file, determining its size, reading its contents into a buffer, and printing the buffer along with optional filename content.

methods.name: int read_file_into_memory(const char * filename,test_ut_memory_t * pInstance)
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into a memory buffer within a provided test_ut_memory_t instance. It opens the file, seeks to determine size, allocates memory, reads data, null-terminates, and handles errors appropriately.

methods.name: void print_input_output(char * kvpData,const char * filename)
methods.description: Prints the contents of a file (if successfully read) along with a provided data string. Calls read_file_into_memory internally to load file contents before printing.
